core.title: Invisible Cabinet Door Hinge for 1/2 Inch Thick Doors, SOSS 101CUS
tags: Invisible Cabinet Door Hinge for 1/2 Inch Thick Doors

text.description_html:
SOSS 101CUS, Invisible Cabinet Door Hinge Pair

SOSS 101CUS hinges are for use on 1/2 inch thick wood doors or metal doors. Package includes one pair of hinges with matching finish #5x3/4 inch wood screws. When the door is closed, SOSS Invisible Hinges cannot be seen or tampered with. When opened, the riveted hinge pin is non-removable. The installed hinge is firmly anchored in a deep, full mortise, which assists the screws in supporting the door, assuring a stronger door hinge installation.

Features and Specifications of the Concealed Cabinet Door Hinges:

  • For use on wood or metal doors.
  • Hinges open a full 180°
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Specifications of the SOSS 101 Invisible Hinges:

  • Hinge Material: High Strength Steel
  • Total Height: 1-11/16"
  • Leaf Plate Width: 3/8"
  • Minimum Door Thickness: 1/2" Thick Door
  • Wood Screws: #5x3/4" (3.5x19mm)
  • SOSS 101CUS Hinge Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold In Pairs (2 Door Hinges)
